about: CHK-13 (R-13): the reviewed inventory of script files that name a database client: a driver specifier in any form, a client command (psql, pg_dump, pg_dumpall, pg_restore, pgcli, createdb, dropdb), or DATABASE_URL. Each has a kind that scripts/ci/own-database-client.test.mjs enforces: launcher and contract construct no client and run no client command; read-only runs its statement through runReadOnlyReport; probe runs only its pinned select 1 body, as the condition of its pinned if or until construct; container-local uses docker exec on a local container for status only and runs no client command; pinned-read-probe is a reviewed read probe pinned byte for byte by its hash in the rules module; owner-operation is the one pinned owner operation, and only its pinned modules stand under another entry; guarded takes every client from the guarded factory (packages/database/src/disposable-client.ts, behind assertDisposableTarget); client-adapter wraps a guarded client it is given and opens none, and is pinned byte for byte by its hash in the rules module.

scripts.reason: The drizzle-kit configuration: hands DATABASE_URL to drizzle-kit, which package scripts run only for generate (no connection); no connecting drizzle-kit command is a package script (schema-push-search).
Resolves the explicit, confirmed --target of the pilot branch audit against DATABASE_URL for scripts/pilot/branch-check.ts (read-only); it opens no client, runs no command and holds no write.
Opens the provisioning client through withDisposableClient and records the limit and its audit receipt in one transaction.

Applies a journal folder with the application's migrator to a guarded client it is given; it imports Drizzle's adapter and migrator only, calls the adapter only on that client, and cannot open a connection.

The pg16 lane's one way to a database: reads the admin URL and opens the admin and scratch clients through withDisposableClient, which refuses every server that is not loopback or the confirmed CI container.
Lists the environment variable names CI must provide; reads no value and opens no connection.
Runs the fast unit lane with DATABASE_URL set to an unreachable loopback port, so no unit test can reach a database.
Local CI parity: exports the CI container defaults (ci-postgres) for the lanes it runs; constructs no client and runs no client command.
Contract check over workflow YAML text: compares the e2e-gate job's DATABASE_URL entries; reads no database.
Matches database-client names and DATABASE_URL only as discovery tokens in test source; never imports a driver or opens a connection.
Launches test lanes after clearing database environment variables for unit tests or requiring the exact disposable CI target for pg16; never imports a driver or opens a connection itself.
Redacts DATABASE_URL values from fetched health output; never reads or uses the variable.
Test fixture naming the variables a package command may read; opens no connection.
Contract check over workflow text for E2E reuse: compares DATABASE_URL wiring; reads no database.
Contract check over workflow text for PR E2E evidence: compares DATABASE_URL wiring; reads no database.
Runs a command with a downloaded Vercel environment file after checking that DATABASE_URL and DATABASE_URL_RLS are present; constructs no client.

Owner-approved staging operation (2026-11-06): manual dispatch from main only, through the staging environment; refuses before connecting unless the reviewed staging authority and both identities hold. Its statements live in enrol-core.mjs, which opens no client.
The reviewed staging authority constants of the owner operation; 'postgres' is the database and role name, not a driver.

The verification-machine probe reads the database list once, with psql inside the local fixture container, through the pinned local Unix-socket endpoint; its exact content is pinned by hash in the rules module.
Checks the names and shape of the database URL variables of the verification run; it opens no client and runs no command.
Test fixtures for the verification-machine probe: a loopback URL and a container description as data; it opens no client.
Z620 lane helper: creates and drops prefix-checked task databases on the Z620 container's server at its fixed loopback address, through a client from the guarded factory (openGuardedClient).
Z620 lane runner: hands the loopback task database URL to the lane it starts; constructs no client.
Z620 evidence manifest: records pg_isready of the local Supabase container through docker exec.
Copies DATABASE_URL from the root env file into the docker env file for local containers; constructs no client.
E2E gate entry: defaults DATABASE_URL to the local Supabase loopback database and runs the gate; constructs no client itself.
E2E web server entry: wires DATABASE_URL and the restricted runtime URL for next start; constructs no client itself.
E2E gatekeeper: two readiness probes run select 1 on DATABASE_URL through embedded node; no other statement.
Defaults DATABASE_URL to the local Supabase loopback database for the lanes it starts; constructs no client.
Defaults DATABASE_URL to the local Supabase loopback database for the lanes it starts; constructs no client.
Defaults DATABASE_URL to the local Supabase loopback database for the checks it starts; constructs no client.
Pilot verification entry: requires DATABASE_URL and runs the pilot checks; constructs no client itself.

Pilot branch report against an explicit host:port/database argument (never a URL or an environment value); its one report statement runs through runReadOnlyReport, proved unable to write by test/pg16/pilot-report-read-only.test.ts.
Reads DATABASE_URL to refuse anything but the loopback restricted-lane database, then hands it to the role set-up and to the staff-detail and branch-dashboard proofs; opens no client itself.
Sets the loopback local-stack default for DATABASE_URL when it is unset and runs an allow-listed command; opens no client itself.
Security scan: inspects the DATABASE_URL text in .env.local for default credentials and a non-loopback host; opens no connection.

Security tests: inspect the DATABASE_URL text in .env.local for default credentials; open no connection.
